import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *
C = cfg(ttl=1000000, capacity=10000)
# build big requests near the per-request cap but keep total under 8388608
n = 10000
per = 8388608 // n  # ~838 bytes
evs=[]
body_len = per - 200
for i in range(n):
    body = bytes([0x61 + (i % 26)]) * body_len
    r = basic_req(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t%d"%i, cid="cid-%d"%i, cseq="1", body=body)
    evs.append(ev(i, "edge", "alice", "internal", r))
doc = env(C, evs)
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("input bytes", len(raw), "wire total", sum(len(e["wire_hex"])//2 for e in evs))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","/app/submission/main.py"], input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print("rc", p.returncode, p.stderr[:300], "elapsed", round(time.time()-t0,2))
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print(out["accepted"], out["replayed"], out["rejected"], out["live"], "outbytes", len(p.stdout))
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && time python3 perf2.py
